mapper.select: SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM ( SELECT u.id, u.username, u.email, u.password_hash AS "passwordHash", u.role, u.enabled FROM users u WHERE u.id = #{id} ) t
SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM ( SELECT u.id, u.username, u.email, u.password_hash AS "passwordHash", u.role, u.enabled FROM users u WHERE u.username = #{username} ) t
SELECT row_to_json(t) FROM ( SELECT u.id, u.username, u.email, u.password_hash AS "passwordHash", u.role, u.enabled FROM users u WHERE u.email = #{email} ) t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash, role, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{user.username}, #{user.email}, #{user.passwordHash}, COALESCE(#{user.role}, 'ROLE_USER'), COALESCE(#{user.enabled}, true), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
